property_summary: For every admissible call to transfer, each low-level call C makes to the callee must be a well-formed transferFrom selector with ABI-encoded arguments (from, _tos[i], v), observed via a recording helper's stored msg.data; the mutant swaps the first two arguments, producing calldata whose decoded first argument equals _tos[i] instead of from.
change_summary: Use the wrong argument order in abi.encodeWithSelector by passing _tos[i] as the first argument and from as the second, changing the calldata and thus the external call behavior.
